title: Why You Feel Forced to Finish What You Start
hook: Your brain creates a powerful urge to complete started tasks.

narration.text: Your brain creates a powerful urge to complete started tasks.
This is called the Zeigarnik effect, and it is about mental commitment.
Once you begin something, your mind remembers it better than completed tasks.
That creates tension until the task is finished.
This is why you might eat all the biscuits or finish a long book.
It is not just about hunger, it is about mental closure.
Notice this next time you start something, then like this if it surprised you, and subscribe for more mind insights.

description: Have you ever felt a strong need to complete a task once you've started it, even if you don't really want to? This video explains the psychological reason behind that powerful urge, known as the Zeigarnik effect. Discover how your brain's need for closure influences your daily actions.
topic: Why you often feel a powerful urge to complete a set of actions once you have started, like eating all the biscuits. This is about mental commitment.
